title: Join a Meeting
description: Find a meeting on your calendar and join it — the basic daily ritual of remote work.

steps.instruction: Open Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, or your company's calendar app
hints: Or go to calendar.google.com in your browser

steps.instruction: Find any upcoming meeting on your calendar and click into it
hints: Today's meetings are usually highlighted at the top or in the day view
If no meetings exist, create a test one with 'Google Meet' enabled

overlay.text: Click a meeting block on the calendar grid

steps.instruction: Click the 'Join with Google Meet' / 'Join Zoom' link on the event
hints: It's usually a prominent button inside the event details popup
Check your mic/camera settings before joining — but not now, we're just practicing
